g.text: Power: 7-9 V barrel jack -> series Schottky -> AMS1117-5.0 (JLC C6187, Basic, SOT-223, Vin max 15 V, dropout 1.3 V) -> +5VA. MP20051DQ (C134275) dropped: JLC page lists 5.5 V max supply and an adjustable 0.8-5 V output, unusable from a 7-9 V jack. A 7 V supply is preferred (dissipation (Vin-5 V) x 0.22 A).

g.desc: Power: 7-9 V barrel jack -> series Schottky -> AMS1117-5.0 (JLC C6187, Basic, SOT-223, Vin max 15 V, dropout 1.3 V) -> +5VA.
